title: Manual Resolve Decision
description: manual-resolve-decision/v2: the document manual-resolve-accepted and manual-resolve-rejected carry, the counterparty's answer to a manual resolve. One document for two event types, because a guard chooses on the type and never reads a payload. The requester cannot answer its own request. The event cites the request and the exceptions it answers; an acceptance resolves them, a rejection says why so the requester can answer it.

exceptionIds.description: The exceptions the request answers, as the event cites them.

reason.description: Required on a rejection, so the requester can answer it.
